name: Al Reyadah CCUS
description: The MENA region's first commercial-scale CCUS facility, capturing CO₂ from Emirates Steel Arkan's plant in Mussafah and piping it ~43 km for enhanced oil recovery in ADNOC onshore fields. Operating since 2016.

name: Habshan CCS
description: ADNOC Gas is building CO₂ capture units at the Habshan gas processing plant for permanent geological storage, with FID taken in September 2023. The project triples ADNOC's capture capacity to ~2.3 Mtpa.

name: Bab Gas Plant CCS
description: A planned CO₂ capture project at ADNOC's Bab gas processing complex, with FEED awarded to Worley in late 2024. Part of ADNOC's target to reach 10 Mtpa of carbon capture capacity by 2030.

name: Uthmaniyah CO₂-EOR
description: Saudi Aramco's first CO₂-EOR demonstration, capturing ~0.8 Mtpa of CO₂ from the Hawiyah gas plant and piping it ~85 km to the Uthmaniyah oil field for enhanced oil recovery. Operating since 2015.

name: Jubail CCS Hub
location: Jubail Industrial City, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia
description: Aramco, Linde and SLB are developing one of the world's largest CCS hubs, targeting ~9 Mtpa of CO₂ capture in its first phase by 2027 with expansion to ~14 Mtpa planned. CO₂ from Aramco gas plants and industrial sources will be stored in onshore saline aquifers.

name: Ras Laffan CCS
description: QatarEnergy's first CCS project, capturing ~2.2 Mtpa of CO₂ from LNG trains at Ras Laffan Industrial City for geological sequestration. Operational since 2019.

name: Ras Laffan CCS Expansion
description: A major CCS project serving QatarEnergy's existing LNG facilities at Ras Laffan, with EPC awarded to Samsung C&T in November 2024. It will capture and sequester up to 4.1 Mtpa, among the world's largest CCS projects.

name: North Field East CCS
description: A CCS project serving QatarEnergy's North Field East LNG expansion, capturing and storing ~2.1 Mtpa of CO₂. Under construction alongside the expansion.

name: North Field South CCS
description: A CCS project serving QatarEnergy's North Field South LNG expansion, capturing and storing ~1.2 Mtpa of CO₂. Under construction alongside the expansion.

name: Meleiha CCS
description: A small CCS pilot by Eni and EGPC at the Meleiha field in Egypt's Western Desert, targeting capture and storage of ~25,000–30,000 tonnes of CO₂ per year. Announced in 2022 as Egypt's first CCS project.

name: Santos Basin Pre-Salt CCUS
location: Santos Basin, offshore Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description: Petrobras' pre-salt CCUS program captures CO₂ from offshore FPSOs and reinjects it into pre-salt reservoirs for enhanced oil recovery, the world's largest offshore CO₂-EOR operation. A record ~14.2 Mt of CO₂ was reinjected in 2024.

name: Rio de Janeiro CCS Pilot
description: Petrobras' first dedicated CCS pilot in Rio de Janeiro state, tendered in September 2025 to inject ~100,000 tonnes of CO₂ per year. A step toward scaling Brazil's geological storage beyond pre-salt EOR.

name: Blue Horizons
description: Shell Oman's planned blue hydrogen/ammonia project with integrated CO₂ capture and dedicated geological storage, using KBR's blue ammonia technology and Wood for pre-FEED. Currently in early development.

name: SACCCS Leandra Pilot
operator: South African Centre for Carbon Capture & Storage (SACCCS)
description: South Africa's pilot CO₂ storage project led by SACCCS, planned at Leandra in Mpumalanga. Long-delayed and still in early development as the country's first CO₂ injection pilot.
